forum.title: Correct OTG_FS FIFO size for STM32H753
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @DZimm.9

Sorry for not coming back to you sooner

the OTG\_FS FIFO size mentioned in the reference manual is the correct one and AN4879 will be corrected in the future

BR

Gyessine
forum.content_text:
Hi,

We are currently using STM32H753 and are setting up USB Fifos. There is some contradictory information about the available sizes.

AN4879 mentions that the available SRAM size is 1.25kBytes for OTG\_FS:

![2026-03-18 13_54_15-an4879-introduction-to-usb-hardware-and-pcb-guidelines-using-stm32-mcus-stmicroe.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/86063cd1-b8e5-910d-67f3-61049a00be90.png "2026-03-18 13_54_15-an4879-introduction-to-usb-hardware-and-pcb-guidelines-using-stm32-mcus-stmicroe.png")

In the reference manual RM0433 I can only find 4kB for both OTG\_HS peripherials, where OTG\_HS1 is used for OTG\_FS:

![2026-03-18 13_56_38-rm0433-stm32h742-stm32h743753-and-stm32h750-value-line-advanced-armbased-32bit-m.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/efe99df6-6488-92b6-f893-74cef23b6508.png "2026-03-18 13_56_38-rm0433-stm32h742-stm32h743753-and-stm32h750-value-line-advanced-armbased-32bit-m.png")

What information is correct?

Thanks and best regards

Daniel
